sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `jules`
- Canonical name: Jules (`claim-jules-sf-identity`, `claim-jules-sf-docs-identity`)
- Current status: FAQ still says Public Beta (`claim-jules-sf-status-faq-beta`). Changelog and the 2025-08-06 blog say Jules is no longer in beta (`claim-jules-sf-status-ga`). Quote both. Do not average.
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-17
- Vendor: Google (Google Labs) (`claim-jules-sf-vendor`)
- Canonical URL: `https://jules.google/` (`claim-jules-sf-canonical-url`)
- Repository: unknown / none. No public product source repo is published. Do not invent `github.com/google/jules` (`claim-jules-sf-repository-url`)
- Availability: Free plan exists. Paid Jules seats are Google AI Pro/Ultra for `@gmail.com`. Workspace is not yet supported. 18+ (`claim-jules-sf-pricing-free`, `claim-jules-sf-availability-gmail`, `claim-jules-sf-availability-age`)

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: an Autonomous Coding Agent that does coding tasks the operator does not want to do. Docs: experimental coding agent that fixes bugs, adds documentation, and builds new features; integrates with GitHub; works autonomously (`claim-jules-sf-identity`, `claim-jules-sf-docs-identity`, `claim-jules-sf-what-it-is`, `claim-jules-sf-intended-user`)
- What it is not: not a co-pilot or code-completion sidekick (`claim-jules-sf-not-copilot`). Not a local agent runtime (`claim-jules-sf-cli-remote`, `claim-jules-sf-execution-location`). Not an operator-key / local-models / official-mobile / official-IDE harness (`claim-jules-sf-byok`, `claim-jules-sf-local-models`, `claim-jules-sf-mobile`, `claim-jules-sf-mobile-access`, `claim-jules-sf-no-ide`)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `cloud-agent` is a catalogue lock from the vendor Cloud VM + plan + PR loop. Pages do not use `cloud-agent` as a product-type label (`claim-jules-sf-primary-type`)
- Agent-loop owner: Jules / Google Labs owns the loop that runs in the Cloud VM (`claim-jules-sf-agent-loop-owner`, `claim-jules-sf-loop`)
- Architecture: Jules fetches the repository, clones it to a Cloud VM, develops a plan with Gemini, executes, and opens a PR. Runtime is a secure short-lived Ubuntu VM with Node/Bun/Python/Go/Java/Rust, 20GB disk, and environment snapshots. Long-lived local dev servers are not the product path (`claim-jules-sf-architecture-vm`, `claim-jules-sf-loop`, `claim-jules-sf-vm-runtime`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: Gemini only. No model picker. Changelog 2026-01-30: Gemini 3 Flash base on all tiers. Changelog 2026-03-09: Gemini 3.1 Pro default for Pro. Homepage/limits may still say 2.5 Pro / 3 Pro; treat those as stale and quote both changelog rows (`claim-jules-sf-model-strategy`, `claim-jules-sf-model-flash`, `claim-jules-sf-model-pro`)
- Auth strategy: Google account. REST API uses Jules-issued keys, not operator Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic keys. MCP allowlist credentials are service keys, not model BYOK (`claim-jules-sf-auth-strategy`, `claim-jules-sf-api`, `claim-jules-sf-mcp`)
- Provider support: Gemini only (`claim-jules-sf-provider-support`)
- BYOK: `unsupported` (`claim-jules-sf-byok`, `claim-jules-sf-auth-strategy`)
- Subscription reuse: `supported` (Google AI Pro / Google AI Ultra / Google One only) (`claim-jules-sf-subscription-reuse`)
- Local models: `unsupported` (`claim-jules-sf-local-models`)

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: per-task fresh short-lived Cloud VM. That is the sourced sandbox cell. Do not flatten to Compare Yes/No (`claim-jules-sf-isolation-fresh-vm`, `claim-jules-sf-vm-runtime`, `claim-jules-sf-tag-sandbox`)
- Permissions: plan-then-execute with a web auto-approve timer; API auto-approves (`claim-jules-sf-permissions`)

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- Pricing: seat, not tokens. Free Jules exists (plan available to all users without cost) at 15 tasks/24h and 3 concurrent, so `$0` is valid (`claim-jules-sf-pricing-free`, `claim-jules-sf-pricing`). Jules in Pro via Google AI Pro `$19.99`/mo (100/15) (`claim-jules-sf-pricing-pro`). Jules in Ultra via Google AI Ultra `$100`/mo (5x) / `$200`/mo (20x). Keep both Ultra list prices. Do not average (`claim-jules-sf-pricing-ultra`, `claim-jules-sf-pricing-google-ai-plans`). Family limits are not pooled (`claim-jules-sf-family-limits`). Paid path is `@gmail.com` (`claim-jules-sf-availability-gmail`)
- License: unknown / hosted Google service. No SPDX identifier is published (`claim-jules-sf-license`)
- Maintenance: changelog rows used in this pass are 2026-01-30 and 2026-03-09 plus the 2025-08-06 left-beta note (`claim-jules-sf-model-flash`, `claim-jules-sf-model-pro`, `claim-jules-sf-status-ga`)
- Lock-in: Gemini-only models, Jules-issued API keys, GitHub-only VCS, Google AI Pro/Ultra seat reuse (`claim-jules-sf-model-strategy`, `claim-jules-sf-byok`, `claim-jules-sf-subscription-reuse`, `claim-jules-sf-surface-github`)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: autonomous Google Labs coding agent that clones a GitHub repo into a fresh Cloud VM, plans with Gemini, executes, and opens a PR, with a `$0` seat plus Google AI Pro/Ultra reuse (`claim-jules-sf-unique-value`, `claim-jules-sf-loop`, `claim-jules-sf-pricing-free`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: Gemini-only; GitHub-only; no operator model BYOK; no local models; no official mobile app; no official IDE plugin; CLI is a remote dashboard; paid seats are Google AI plans on `@gmail.com`; FAQ Public Beta vs changelog/blog no-longer-in-beta (`claim-jules-sf-drawback`, `claim-jules-sf-status-faq-beta`, `claim-jules-sf-status-ga`)
- Best fit: operators who want autonomous GitHub coding tasks they do not want to do (`claim-jules-sf-intended-user`)
- Not-for: not a co-pilot; not a local/BYOK/local-models/mobile/IDE harness (`claim-jules-sf-not-copilot`, `claim-jules-sf-byok`, `claim-jules-sf-local-models`, `claim-jules-sf-mobile`, `claim-jules-sf-no-ide`)
